title: blacklist check_and_blacklist SELECT then UPDATE without transaction
description: In crates/transit/src/peering/blacklist.rs, check_and_blacklist reads consecutive_failures in one query then updates it in a second query. Two concurrent sessions processing errors from the same peer can both read the same pre-threshold count and both update without triggering a blacklist, allowing the failure threshold to be silently exceeded. Wrap in BEGIN IMMEDIATE or use a single atomic UPDATE ... WHERE ... RETURNING.
